protocol.attack_selection: Fixed corruption uses the first candidate for both classes (original if absent). Directed evasion selects the lowest phishing score including the original for phishing only; legitimate stays clean. ASR denominator is all clean-detected phishing, including no-candidate parents. Also report all-model and parent/defense common eligibility, source/family counts, query totals, effective token no-ops and parent-selected transfer. Pretrained clean comparison is separate; no pretrained robustness claim.
protocol.inference: Use each existing reviewed adapter unchanged, including preprocessing, label mapping, CPU float32 neural settings and 256/512-token limits. Baseline accepts full validated text. No downloads or training.
protocol.integrity: Before scoring, require the committed freeze manifest, a clean tracked worktree, all frozen code/reference hashes and all 79 preserved file hashes. Validate the original reserve manifest, IDs, groups, sources, labels and bytes. Reject exact preprocessed training/validation overlap for originals or candidates; abort instead of dropping rows. Keep existing split/group membership on disk; use an in-memory test view for the frozen perturbation library. No cohort edits or label changes.

protocol.no_tuning: Do not refit, recalibrate, replace models, choose thresholds, alter attacks, relabel or select a deployment winner based on reserve outcomes. Stop on integrity/boundary failure; disclose any implementation correction and its timing. Changes to experimental choices require a new external test cohort, not reuse of this reserve as fresh evidence.
protocol.postscore_review: After all scores are fixed, select up to two false positives and two false negatives per model by SHA256('final-clean-review-v1:'+example_id), union/deduplicate IDs. Review up to two successful defended worst-of-budget variants per operation, ranked by SHA256('final-attack-review-v1:'+example_id); when an operation has no defended successes, use original-BERT successes for that operation. Record supported/ambiguous/invalid without altering primary publisher labels, models, thresholds, attacks or counts. Keep raw excerpts local; publish text-free judgments only. Review is AI-assisted and bounded, not exhaustive human certification.
protocol.primary_clean: All 703 originals with publisher labels: confusion counts, accuracy, balanced accuracy, precision, phishing recall, F1 and legitimate false-positive rate. Report per-source results and truncation; undefined class denominators remain null.
protocol.primary_robustness: One fresh model-independent candidate bank with seed 9042. Reuse the unchanged stage-6 three transformations, protected spans and bounds: at most 12 candidates plus 1 clean query per parent/model, at most 3 changed words and 10 percent of body words, first 1500 body characters only. Same candidate texts for all three trained models; no early stopping or extra probes.
protocol.reproduction: Run the complete frozen evaluation twice to new output directories; independently recount metrics/query budgets, compare prediction and bank bytes, check unchanged model/data files and in-memory weight digests. The repeat is numerical reproduction, not independent new evidence.
